name: evoting
description: Sistem de vot electronic verificabil end-to-end (licență UDJG, ACIEE)

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @evoting/backend -w @evoting/trustee -w @evoting/verifier -w @evoting/simulator -w @evoting/attacks && npm run build -w web
